title.narrative: Optimizing Development Coordination: Advancing Strategic Planning and Reporting through Information System Enhancement, PHASE I

description.narrative: Montenegro faces growing pressure to strengthen its institutional capacities, enhance its policy and strategic framework, and ensure the timely implementation of measures to meet the complex demands of EU negotiations, the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), and national development priorities. The overall objective of the project is to increase the effective implementation of national reforms, leading to advanced EU accession and sustainable development. This will be achieved through strengthened governance mechanisms, improved institutional coordination, and enhanced evidence-based policymaking, all of which will be supported by a dedicated digital approach. Enhanced cross-government and institutional coordination efficiency, enabling evidence-based policy planning, data-driven decision-making, optimized resource allocation across priority reforms, and a dedicated digital approach to monitoring/reporting is the expected outcome of the project.The project is the result of collaboration between the General Secretariat of the Government (GSG), the Ministry of European Affairs (MEA), the Ministry of Finance (MF), the Ministry of Public Administration (MPA), and the UNDP CO Montenegro. Given the complex nature of the objective, and the natural links between key strategic documents and sector-specific strategies and programmes, other stakeholders from various government sectors (e.g. other ministries/institutions) as well as relevant international organizations and civil society organizations will be involved to ensure effective implementation and sustainable outcomes. Collaboration with these stakeholders will ensure alignment with key national overarching policies and facilitate access to relevant resources and expertise.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
